candidate_state_rule.concordant_down: RNA, protein, and selected phosphosite all have BH q <= 0.05 and negative Cliff's delta.
candidate_state_rule.concordant_up: RNA, protein, and selected phosphosite all have BH q <= 0.05 and positive Cliff's delta.
candidate_state_rule.discordant: RNA, protein, and selected phosphosite all have BH q <= 0.05, and their three Cliff's delta signs are not all the same.
candidate_state_rule.mixed_or_indeterminate: The candidate is analyzable but has exactly one significant layer, exactly two same-sign significant layers, or another pattern not covered by a primary, secondary, or null state.
candidate_state_rule.secondary_two_layer_discordant: Exactly two layers have BH q <= 0.05 and their Cliff's delta signs oppose. This state is reported separately and excluded from the primary exact-binomial population.
candidate_state_rule.unavailable: A required open record, approved join, unique identifier, or minimum group size is absent.

analysis.effect_size: Cliff's delta for altered versus unaltered cases
analysis.group_definition: Altered means at least one eligible nonsynonymous somatic variant in the open GDC masked MAF for the exact joined tumor sample. Unaltered means no eligible variant in that same frozen MAF and an otherwise eligible joined sample.
analysis.phosphosite_rule: For each candidate, choose the sequence-valid phosphosite with greatest nonmissing sample coverage. Break ties by lowest one-based position, then residue ASCII order. Do not inspect effects or p-values during selection.

primary_binomial_rule.failure: discordant, defined as three significant layers whose Cliff's delta signs are not all the same
primary_binomial_rule.population: Frozen candidates with BH q <= 0.05 for RNA, protein, and selected phosphosite
primary_binomial_rule.success: concordant, defined as three significant layers whose Cliff's delta signs are all the same
primary_binomial_rule.zero_population: If the population count is zero, report the primary exact-binomial test as unavailable with no p-value and still release preregistered candidate-layer and secondary results.

analysis.primary_test: Two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test for each candidate and each of RNA, protein, and the selected phosphosite.

excluded_input_rows.reason: Open Targets returned more than one UniProt Swiss-Prot cross-reference, so the identity rule refused CDKN2A.

procedure: Use Open Targets Platform release 26.09 and disease MONDO_0018177.
Request the first 20 associatedTargets rows in the API-defined overall association order before any GDC or PDC outcome is read.
Retain a row only when it has one Ensembl targetId, one approved symbol, and exactly one UniProt Swiss-Prot cross-reference.
Do not backfill an excluded row.
Freeze the resulting set and display it by Ensembl gene ID, not by association score.
candidate_selection.use_boundary: This is a preregistered study frame, not a product ranking and not a claim of therapeutic relevance.

exclusion: Any record or file requiring login, token, dbGaP approval, Synapse access approval, or other controlled-data permission
Samples without an exact one-to-one patient and sample join
Recurrent samples in the primary Discovery analysis
inclusion: PDC000204 and PDC000205 GBM tumor cases in their frozen version-specific releases
Open GDC CPTAC-3 clinical, biospecimen, masked somatic mutation MAF, and gene expression files from release 46.0
One exact tumor sample per patient with explicit source relationships across required modalities
cohort.name: CPTAC GBM Discovery open multi-omics intersection
replication_scope: PDC000446 and PDC000448 as a later GBM-filtered confirmatory cohort
PDC000514 and PDC000515 as a later independent longitudinal cohort

gates.measure: Every selected file has a verified current license or data-use term and is downloadable without credentials, application, or click-through terms that prohibit the study.
PDC study UUID and version, GDC release and manifest, source file size, and source file SHA-256 are pinned.

gates.failure_action: stop the first study and publish a feasibility refusal only
gates.measure: Unique one-to-one PDC to GDC patient joins divided by eligible PDC Discovery GBM cases.
gates.threshold: at least 0.80 and zero one-to-many joins

gates.failure_action: stop the first study and publish a feasibility refusal only
gates.measure: Exact one-to-one tumor sample joins with mutation, RNA, proteome, and phosphoproteome divided by patient-joined GBM tumor samples.
gates.threshold: at least 0.60, at least 60 complete cases, and zero one-to-many joins

gates.failure_action: mark the affected candidate unavailable; stop inferential release if fewer than eight candidates remain
gates.measure: Candidates with at least five altered and twenty unaltered complete cases plus one sequence-valid phosphosite.

gates.failure_action: mark the affected layer unavailable; stop inferential release when the complete-chain threshold fails
gates.measure: Missing values per layer among exact joined samples and complete-chain sample count.
gates.threshold: mutation status 0 missing; RNA, protein, and selected phosphosite each at most 0.30 missing; complete-chain cases at least 60

gates.measure: Unresolved gene, protein, phosphosite, patient, or sample identity conflicts and guessed aliases.
gates.threshold: zero conflicts, zero guessed aliases, and 100 percent sequence validation for selected phosphosites

gates.measure: All confirmatory candidate-layer p-values are corrected in one Benjamini-Hochberg family.

gates.failure_action: report the aggregate primary exact-binomial test as unavailable with no p-value; continue reporting candidate-layer and secondary results
gates.measure: Frozen candidates with BH q <= 0.05 for RNA, protein, and selected phosphosite
gates.threshold: at least one candidate to compute an exact-binomial p-value

gates.measure: Two clean offline builds from identical pinned inputs and environment plus an independent count verifier.
gates.threshold: byte-identical canonical outputs and receipts; exact agreement on denominators, missing counts, join counts, and conflict counts

gates.measure: Every frozen candidate has exactly one result-shape record; primary population, success, and failure counts; secondary two-layer counts; and every exclusion, null, negative, unavailable, and conflict count are present.
gates.threshold: 19 of 19 candidates and all preregistered metrics

gates.measure: Public artifact scan and non-clinical copy review.
gates.threshold: zero controlled files, patient records, credentials, private paths, diagnostic or treatment claims, target labels, or causal claims

hypotheses.alternative: Within the primary population, the probability that all three effect directions are concordant is greater than 0.5.
hypotheses.failure: discordant, defined as three significant layers whose Cliff's delta signs are not all the same
hypotheses.null: Within the primary population, the probability that all three effect directions are concordant is at most 0.5.
hypotheses.population: Frozen candidates with BH q <= 0.05 for RNA, protein, and selected phosphosite
hypotheses.success: concordant, defined as three significant layers whose Cliff's delta signs are all the same
hypotheses.test: One-sided exact binomial test with p0 = 0.5 after candidate-layer BH correction; no test or p-value when the primary population is empty

hypotheses.alternative: Altered and unaltered groups differ in RNA, protein, or selected phosphosite abundance for at least one frozen candidate.
hypotheses.null: For each frozen candidate and molecular layer, altered and unaltered groups have the same abundance distribution.
hypotheses.test: Two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum tests with one Benjamini-Hochberg family

question: Within the open-only CPTAC GBM Discovery cohort, how often do exact sample-linked somatic mutation group contrasts have the same direction across RNA abundance, protein abundance, and an outcome-blind selected phosphosite for the frozen candidate set?

result_shapes.label: concordant
result_shapes.meaning: RNA, protein, and selected phosphosite all pass the BH threshold and all three effect signs match. This is a primary exact-binomial success, not a causal or clinical conclusion.

result_shapes.label: discordant
result_shapes.meaning: RNA, protein, and selected phosphosite all pass the BH threshold and their three effect signs are not all the same. This is a primary exact-binomial failure.

result_shapes.label: secondary_two_layer_discordant
result_shapes.meaning: Exactly two layers pass the BH threshold and their signs oppose. This is a separately reported secondary state and is excluded from the primary exact-binomial population.

result_shapes.label: null
result_shapes.meaning: No candidate layer passes the preregistered BH threshold. Null results remain visible.

result_shapes.label: mixed_or_indeterminate
result_shapes.meaning: The candidate is analyzable but has one significant layer, two same-sign significant layers, or another pattern outside the declared primary, secondary, and null states.

result_shapes.label: unavailable
result_shapes.meaning: A source, access, join, mapping, group-size, sequence, or missingness gate prevents analysis. Unavailable is not negative evidence.

result_shapes.label: feasibility_refusal
result_shapes.meaning: A study-level stop gate failed. Only gate metrics and blockers may be released.
